from.place: Proof (3): ordinary action-preserving scalar comparison underlying the flat degree-zero derived comparison.

title: Action-preserving presentations for ordinary scalar extension
statement: For a morphism phi:R to B of sheaves of commutative rings on an essentially small site, Modules R is the existing category of R-module sheaves, scalarAlgebra phi is B with scalars restricted through phi, and tensorSection is the image of a sectionwise pure tensor in the localization tensor. An Identifications presentation consists of the actual algebra multiplication and unit, an equivalence from R-modules to modules over the tensor unit, an equivalence from B-module sheaves to internal modules over the restricted algebra, the specified underlying R-module identifications, the sectionwise action equations, and additivity. monExtension is the existing Mod.extendScalars along the algebra unit transported through these equivalences. projection is its actual coequalizer projection transported through the underlying identifications.
